known_limitations.title: Integrity under external SIGKILL mid-call is outside the supported envelope
known_limitations.statement: AISEF 2.1 does NOT guarantee journal/usage integrity when the process is killed by an external SIGKILL during the narrow window between a provider request being sent and its result/usage being journaled. This window is outside the V2.1 supported envelope.
known_limitations.owner_ruling: Option 2 — documented scope limitation (no further SIGKILL fault-injection).
known_limitations.honesty_note: NOT represented as fixed or fully verified. The supplementary campaign was clean (0 TIMEOUT/INFRA; the _create T0 test_v21_continue_integrity PASSED this run, 212.87s) — that is evidence of a clean measurement environment, not closure of the external-SIGKILL window.
known_limitations.scope_of_effect: the soundness qualifier on A-01 (cli.py::_parser 31/31 killed) and A-02 (bundle_cli.py::_create 3/3 killed) and every target whose kill set includes test_v21_continue_integrity.py; those head kill numbers are accepted under this documented envelope limitation.
known_limitations.severity: LOW — narrow external-signal window; normal termination paths (budget stop, turn cap, timeout, interrupt) journal and redact in a finally block and are covered.

residual_risks_owner_accepted.what: 7 unaudited mutation survivors in 2 targets (client.py::session x3, story_runner.py::_attempt x4), accepted as scoped residual risks.
residual_risks_owner_accepted.authoritative_detail: closure-evidence/v2/cycle2/RELEASE-DECISIONS.json seq 6, field accepted_survivors.survivors — each with target, position, mutant, source_sha256, engineering one-label class, and the effect re-verified against the product source at 8c7bdb44.
residual_risks_owner_accepted.summary: All 7 are verdict/obligation/evidence-neutral on the path in use: the _attempt role mutants (S-01/S-02) route identically at MeasurementPoint.CANDIDATE and the role is not journaled nor on Proof; the _attempt label mutants (S-03/S-04) change a journal label that is not an identity/release key; the client.session mutants change only the session result's REPORT fields (the 'redacted' count and the 'left_range_gone' naming) while redact() and _release_session() both run unconditionally in a finally before the dict is built, so redaction and scope-disposal enforcement are intact.
residual_risks_owner_accepted.gate_effect: The machine mutation gate verdict is PRESERVED as FAIL (UNAUDITED_SURVIVORS = 7). The owner acceptance is a risk-based decision recorded ABOVE the gate; it does NOT convert the gate FAIL to PASS, the survivors are NOT labelled KILLED, no audit evidence is fabricated, and no historical measurement is modified.
residual_risks_owner_accepted.not_done: No test added and no product code changed to eliminate these survivors (owner directive 2026-10-31 §1, §3).
